text:
maya: FYI incidentbot didn't page oncall for prod latency alert :warning: we've got SLO breaches for search-api customers.
incident-bot: incident-bot: page suppressed by suppressor (route_filter) for team=oncall-sre, incident=INC-2026-483, reason=duplicate-route-match
sam: walking through logs now — can someone confirm the alert_id?
maya: alert_id: search_latency_99_500ms_2026-03-17
jorge: I see the webhook delivered, but pagerflow returned 202 + reason="suppressed" in payload. digging.
emily: manual page sent to oncall sideline via Ops -> paging phone :rotating_light:
sam: where's the handoff data? did rotation change at 06:00Z?
maya: yes rotation updated 05:58Z, maybe mapping not propagated.
incident-bot: incident-bot: routing table last-refreshed=2026-03-17T05:50:12Z
liam: that looks stale. Rotation was updated after that window. Need to force refresh.
sam: doing a config push to notifier-service: `curl -X POST https://internal/notifier/refresh` — will monitor.
incident-bot: refresh triggered by sam — result=ok, new-routes=oncall-sre-v2
maya: manual mitigation: put temporary suppressor override, re-enabled paging for search-api alerts.
emily: customers impacted: 3 tenants saw 10-30s latency spikes during window, CS notified and doing outreach. :eyes:
sam: root cause hypothesis: route refresh race between rotation sync and notifier caching. Needs TTL reduction.
jorge: logs: `notifier.cache.get(route) -> TTL=3600s, last_update=05:50Z, rotation_change=05:58Z` — yep.
liam: quick fix: reduce cache TTL to 60s and roll. planning PR now.
maya: agree. also need postmortem and follow-up tasks: adjust cache TTL, add synthetic check for pagerflow suppression, add alert that triggers if page suppressed AND customers impacted.
emily: filed CS tickets and PSA draft in #customer-commms.
maya: thanks all. I'll start incident ticket. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: incident-bot: incident INC-2026-483 created, priority=P2, assignee=maya
sam: will pair on postmortem tomorrow 16:00 PT.
